product.title: Columbia River Gorge Waterfalls Tour

description.text: Travel from Portland along the Historic Columbia River Highway to Crown Point, Latourell Falls, and Multnomah Falls. This small-group outing visits Vista House overlooks and gorge waterfalls with time for photos and short walks when trail conditions allow.

highlights: Drive the Historic Columbia River Highway from Portland
Stop at Crown Point and Vista House overlooks
Visit Latourell Falls and Multnomah Falls
Small-group van transport with a local guide
Photo stops at Columbia River Gorge viewpoints

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Travel from Portland along the Historic Columbia River Highway to Crown Point, Latourell Falls, and Multnomah Falls.

itineraryItems.title: Troutdale and Crown Point
itineraryItems.description: Begin east of Portland with views from Crown Point above the Columbia River.

itineraryItems.title: Vista House
itineraryItems.description: Explore the historic observatory and gorge panoramas at Crown Point.

itineraryItems.title: Latourell Falls
itineraryItems.description: Visit the columnar-basalt waterfall with an optional short paved trail.

itineraryItems.title: Multnomah Falls
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Oregon's tallest waterfall with time near the lodge and viewing platform.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
